narrative: The LiteLLM KEV listing realizes the claimed condition: an inference-serving proxy is now a credential-bearing supply-chain node. Because it brokers calls across hundreds of providers, an attacker reaching its unauthenticated MCP endpoints reads every connected service's credentials and pivots across the inference stack. That confirmed, KEV-deadlined blast radius is the coherent AI-Infra attack-surface category this prediction said inference runtimes form.
remaining_gap: No NIST/NVD AI-Infra tag, OWASP Top-10 promotion, or per-engine SBOM signature feeds yet; the category is exploited in the wild but not formally codified.
